lead.headline: Love's back is on the report — and Allen can't cover
lead.deck: Jefferson is limited too; both fallbacks have to be decided on Friday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Jordan Love was listed limited with a back injury on Wednesday, in a walk-through estimate (Packers.com, NBC/PFT 21 Oct), and AVIATO's only other quarterback, Josh Allen, is on bye. Justin Jefferson was limited with the ankle again (Vikings.com 21 Oct), and his fallback, DK Metcalf, plays in Paris at 07:30 Sunday — before Minnesota's inactives. So both calls move to Friday: if Love is still on the report, add Matthew Stafford (free from Thursday, kicks off with Love) and drop Alvin Kamara; if Jefferson is doubtful or out, start Metcalf. JuiceJam added Jordan Addison today and close to 104.3 against 130.8; ESPN has AVIATO 64%.

doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire today — Love and Jefferson are decided by Friday's reports.
